```{r}
# Loading
data <- read.csv(
  "Bejaia_Algeria_Fire_Dataset_SR_Project.csv",
  skip = 1,
  strip.white = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
# Inspecting the dataset
head(data)
str(data)
summary(data)
colSums(is.na(data))
```


```{r}
# Removing day and year
data$day <- NULL
data$year <- NULL
```


```{r}
# Converting month to a categorical variable
data$month <- factor(
  data$month,
  levels = c(6, 7, 8, 9),
  labels = c("June", "July", "August", "September")
)
```


```{r}
# Checking the monthly observations
table(data$month)

```
